dialogues.speaker: Tribal Announcement
dialogues.text: "The People of the Springs welcome you, guests from afar! You are currently at the east entrance to our tribal lands."

dialogues.speaker: Tribal Announcement
dialogues.text: "This noticeboard will display important tribal announcements, must-know information for tourists, and various ads from major stores. We hope you will find what you need here, and do enjoy your stay!"
